data.name: Job
data.gender_notes: Job is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Job is recorded in name-lists as “Perfect, blameless”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Job expresses “Perfect, blameless”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Job total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
